edges.reason: msg.sender selects the user reservation records read in _settleTokens
msg.sender indexes unremovedTokens and receives the removal reservation in removeLiquidity
msg.sender indexes receivedCollaterals and totalReceivedCollateral in addLiquidity
msg.sender selects the balance entry settled and paid in claimReward
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom
msg.sender is compared against OWNER in onlyBonusProvider for updateTotalReward
OWNER gate restricts execution of updateTotalReward
amount parameter is stored into unremovedTokens and totalUnremovedTokens
unsentToken is credited to the user balance inside _updateBalanceDataForLiquidityMove
collateralPerTokenE8 is written into shareData for the next term
receivedCollaterals[msg.sender].value += amount.toUint128() performs unchecked uint128 addition, risking overflow
totalReceivedCollateral[_currentTerm] += amount.toUint128() performs unchecked uint128 addition, risking overflow
totalUnremovedTokens[_currentTerm] += amount performs unchecked uint128 addition in removeLiquidity
unremovedTokens[msg.sender].value += amount performs unchecked uint128 addition in removeLiquidity
renewMaturity sets isTotalSupplyDanger when the accumulated share total would overflow uint128
trancheBonds is gated by isActive and endCoolTime which depend on block.timestamp and lastTrancheTime
liquidateBonds is gated by the afterMaturity modifier comparing block.timestamp to maturity
_sendTokens forwards the payout to _transferETH
_reserveAsset forwards reserved ETH to _transferETH
_transferETH executes a low-level call with value to the recipient
The recipient contract can reenter _settleTokens while the ETH send is in progress
The recipient can reenter removeLiquidity before its reservation state is cleared, duplicating withdrawals
unremovedTokens[msg.sender] is deleted only after the external ETH call returns
User balance and reward data are updated after the external ETH transfer, allowing inconsistent reentrant reads
addLiquidity settles pending liquidity before crediting new collateral
removeLiquidity settles pending liquidity before recording the new reservation
transferFrom validates allowance and delegates the share move to _transferToken
_transferToken updates both parties' balance data through _updateBalanceData
_updateBalanceDataForLiquidityMove writes refreshed balance and reward fields
claimReward reads the totalRewards schedule when accruing the payable reward
claimReward transfers the accrued reward tokens via safeTransfer
liquidateBonds calls liquidateBond and burnAll on external bond contracts

normalization_plan.reason: The external amount parameter only feeds removeLiquidity's unchecked uint128 reservation updates
The recipient parameter is only consumed by the owner-only ReserveEth ETH payout function
unsentETH is the transient payout value computed and forwarded inside _settleTokens
unsentToken is only propagated into the balance update routine after settlement
collateralPerTokenE8 is a transient ratio computed and stored by renewMaturity
